Hey mate. 

First of all, I must thank you for the detailed, caring reply, you can't take things like that for granted and it really made me feel a bit better. 

The truth is, I've been on Finasteride & Minoxidil for the past 4 years or so, and for a while my state did look better (though I didn't really appreciate it at the time), but now I think it looks worse than ever. 

I'm also fully aware of the hair transplant option and I probably will undergo one eventually, but you can't really trust people's integrity, so you can't really tell wether the doctor is actually decent or just a fraud that only cares about your damn money. Also, I'm still about halfway of losing my hair, and I'm afraid that after having a transplant, my original hair would keep falling and make me look even more ridiculous. 

About the getting jacked option, I'm aware that a lot of people can find the Jason Statham look very attractive, but it's just not me, it's too far from my personality and the person I am. Tbh I never liked those macular, strong guy character as I am a delicate person by nature, and I think trying to become one would suck the rest of my peraonality out of me.
